name: Rinrin
source:
A slime girl who appeared right before the time of the Demon King's resurrection. Her fighting power is very high as she is able to make full use of her shapeshifting, hardening, and regeneration abilities. The Demon King is very confident in her capabilities, and she has been made a captain in the Demon King's army due to her being able to pivot from offense to defense (and vice versa) very quickly.

She has a very girlish personality and occasionally desires to be pampered by her 'mother', Ishtar.

[Translated from the [url=https://ninetail.info/td16/VenusBloodSavior_character.html]official website[/url]]
